subject.name: Filipino Identity Through the Arts
subject.description: Official Grade 11 Filipino Identity Through the Arts competency records.

domains.name: A. Worldviews and how they are shaped by geography, history and institutions
B. Filipino worldview, constructions of identity, and their manifestations in indigenous and traditional arts
C. Significant features and characteristics of selected indigenous and traditional Philippine music, dance, and theater
D. Geographic, historical, cultural, political, economic, and social contexts of the selected samples of indigenous or traditional Philippine music, dance, and theater
F. Exemplars from the communities and artists of indigenous or traditional Philippine music, dance, and theater art forms
G. Devised performances drawn from indigenous and traditional music, dance and theater
A. Significant features and characteristics of selected indigenous and traditional Philippine visual arts, literary arts, and architecture

standards.text: Learners demonstrate an understanding of Philippine indigenous and traditional arts as repositories of memory and collective human experience, as constructions of Filipino identity, and as wellsprings for continuity and innovation in the performing arts.
Learners create performances that integrate significant aspects of indigenous and traditional expressions as markers of Filipino identity and heritage.

The learners demonstrate an understanding of Philippine indigenous and traditional arts as repositories of memory and collective human experience, as constructions of Filipino identity, and as wellsprings for continuity and innovation in visual arts, literary arts, and architecture
The learners create artistic works that integrate local materials and significant aspects of indigenous and traditional arts as markers of Filipino identity and heritage.
